clause: Library ops through sandbox->validation->PromotionGate; breaking update = validation failure [STU-DS-021]

scope.summary: Route model-authored library publish, update-review, and swap operations through the sandbox -> validation -> PromotionGate lifecycle before authority rows change. A library update that would break instances is a validation failure (a blocking StudioValidationDescriptor finding), not an accepted mutation.
acceptance_criteria: library ops gated by promotion; instance-breaking update is a validation failure, not a mutation
expected_tests: live: model library op enters sandbox->validation->PromotionGate before authority write (fails closed)
negative: an update that would break instances is rejected as a blocking validation finding

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Model library edits bypass validation; breaking updates corrupt consumers.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
